argus-final.name: argus-final
argus-final.notes: CADC argus 1.0.27 from its digest-pinned vendor image over PostgreSQL 17 + pgsphere (benchmarks/tap-compare/docker-compose.argus.yml), the corpus as a plain caom2.obscore table, under final-skycell/pins/argus.yml: cpuset 8-15. Unchanged between the phases, its UWS job store truncated before each.

dachs-final.name: dachs-final
dachs-final.notes: GAVO DaCHS from the Debian gavodachs2-server package (benchmarks/tap-compare/docker-compose.dachs.yml), rebuilt and re-ingested for this protocol, under final-skycell/pins/dachs.yml: cpus 8 on cpuset 16-23, 8 GiB, its PostgreSQL sized by the 1/4 rule. Unchanged between the phases.

egernia-skycell-w8.name: egernia-skycell-w8
egernia-skycell-w8.notes: Phase B. The same stack under final-skycell/pins/egernia-w8.yml + skycell.yml: TAP_API_WORKERS=8 and PostgreSQL's parallel budget re-derived for the pool total, exactly as final/ phase B.
